tools.name: sourcetrail_list_projects
tools.description: List recently opened Sourcetrail projects and show the currently loaded project

tools.name: sourcetrail_load_project
tools.description: Load a Sourcetrail project file (.srctrlprj) for querying

tools.name: sourcetrail_fuzzy_search
tools.description: Search for symbols (classes, functions, variables, etc.) in the loaded project using fuzzy matching

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

tools.name: sourcetrail_graph_query
tools.description: Generate a graph showing relationships for a symbol (inheritance for classes, calls for functions, includes for files). Returns PlantUML diagram format.

symbolFullNames.description: Array of serialized symbol names (use serializedName from fuzzy_search results)

tools.name: sourcetrail_custom_graph_query
tools.description: Find paths between two symbols with optional filtering by node types (class, function, field) and edge types (call, inheritance, usage)

symbolFullNames.description: Exactly two serialized symbol names: [origin, target]

nodeTypes.description: Filter by node types (e.g., ['class', 'function']). Empty means all types.

edgeTypes.description: Filter by edge types (e.g., ['call', 'inheritance']). Empty means all types.

tools.name: sourcetrail_get_code
tools.description: Retrieve source code content from a file, optionally specifying a line range

codeFilePath.description: Absolute path to source code file

startLine.description: Starting line number (1-indexed). Omit or use -1 for start of file.

endLine.description: Ending line number (inclusive). Omit or use -1 for end of file.
